q: The cohomology of BG (classifying space of a group G) in HoTT corresponds to:
opts: The type K(G,1) (the Eilenberg-MacLane space), defined as the connected 1-type with π₁ = G, and the cohomology H*(K(G,1)) = group cohomology H*(G)
exp: BG = K(G,1) in HoTT is defined as the groupoid quotient (or delooping) of G: a type with a point ⋆ and π₁(BG) = G. The cohomology H*(BG) computes the group cohomology H*(G). In HoTT, this is constructed via the 'delooping' using HITs or the quotient type.
